input_class: all original tracked non-test files excluding planning and changed authoring-only Atlas catalog
basis: Firstmate094 permits supplementary reuse with exact unchanged-input mapping. Listed non-test build/CLI/dependency/release/agent-contract commands have unchanged source, embedded execution, scripts and relevant docs. Atlas changes are authoring-only, checked separately by atlas-ready and final package tests. No current equivalence claimed for old full package tests, vet, lint, canon/Atlas or boundary scanner.
limits: Original commands retain original dates/SHA/result; reuse is not rerun. Full package normal/race on frozen candidate pending. Runtime-preflight stays cached and CP29 debts stay historical.
